breaking.member: og.Collider.shape, ShapeDesc.shape, og.SoftBody.shape, og.Cloth.simulation, og.Garment.simulation, og.SoftBody.simulation, og.Fluid3D.simulation
breaking.change: Each is a string enum, no longer a u32 code: ColliderShape (box, sphere, capsule, cylinder, convex, trimesh, heightfield, diamond, hexagon), SoftBodyShape (sphere, box, mesh) and Simulation (gameplay, visual). Code 0 was a box on a collider and a sphere on a soft body; the names say which. Reading the field gives the name. The stored codes are the variants' indices, so saved worlds and cooked rows keep their meaning; scene text takes the variant's name, as RigidBody.kind does.
breaking.fix: Write the variant's name where a number or a constant was: shape: "sphere", simulation: "visual". Drop the SHAPE_*, SOFT_* and SIMULATION_* names from imports of @origingame/engine (the codemods below rewrite the og.-qualified ones), and compare a read shape or simulation with the name, not a number.

breaking.fix: Write "box" where og.SHAPE_BOX was; a bare imported SHAPE_BOX takes the same string and leaves the import.
